parameter.name: inputSource
parameter.description: Where the input comes from: 'Message Body' (default, the raw payload) or 'Expression' (read from sourceContent).

parameter.name: sourceContent
parameter.description: Input to process: an expression such as ${payload} (default), ${vars.x}, or a property. Falls back to the payload.

parameter.name: charset
parameter.description: Charset for TEXT input/output. Default: UTF-8.

parameter.name: outputType
parameter.description: How the recovered output is represented: TEXT (default) or BINARY (base64).

parameter.name: decryptionConfigKey
parameter.description: Name of the PGP Private Key connection used to decrypt (key and passphrase come from the connection).

parameter.name: verificationConfigKey
parameter.description: Name of the PGP Public Key connection holding the signer's key.

parameter.name: requireIntegrity
parameter.description: Reject messages with no integrity-protection (MDC) packet. true (default) or false.

parameter.name: requireValidSignerKey
parameter.description: Reject signatures made with a revoked or expired signer key. true (default) or false.

parameter.name: responseVariable
parameter.description: Name of the variable to store the operation output.

parameter.name: overwriteBody
parameter.description: Replace the message body with the operation output. true or false (default).
